paragraphs: The GLC Coupe has been part of the GLC-Class range since 2015, and across its two generations has used multiple different engines - from the original M274 and OM651 units through to the current M254, OM654, OM656 and M139 hybrid setups. The full breakdown by engine code is below.
about.boldParagraph: We continue to rebuild and replace M256 engines for every GLC COUPE on the road.

cards.body: A 2.0-litre four-cylinder petrol fitted to the GLC200 and GLC300 in the first-generation X253. No specific known issue confirmed for this application. We service it to the same standard as our other GLC Coupe rebuilds.

A 2.0-litre four-cylinder petrol with mild-hybrid technology, fitted to the GLC200 and GLC300 in the current X254 generation from 2023. No specific known issue confirmed for this application - it's a newer design. We service it to the same standard as our other GLC Coupe rebuilds.

A 2.0-litre four-cylinder diesel fitted to early X253-generation GLC220d and GLC300d models. Known for injector seal leakage and timing chain wear - see the callout above. We replace injector seals and timing chain components as standard on every OM651 rebuild.

A 2.0-litre four-cylinder diesel fitted to later X253 and all X254 GLC220d/GLC300d models. No specific known issue confirmed for this application - it's a newer design from the OM651. We service it to the same standard as our other GLC Coupe rebuilds.

A 3.0-litre inline-six diesel with mild-hybrid technology, fitted to the GLC400d in the current X254 generation. No specific known issue confirmed for this application - it's a newer design. We service it to the same standard as our other GLC Coupe rebuilds.

A 3.0-litre V6 petrol fitted to the GLC43 AMG in the first-generation X253. No specific known issue confirmed for this application - it's a well-established Mercedes V6. We service it to the same standard as our other GLC Coupe rebuilds.

A 2.0-litre four-cylinder hybrid petrol fitted to the GLC43 and GLC63 AMG in the current X254 generation. No specific known issue confirmed for this application - it's a very new design and should not inherit the M177/V8 story from the previous generation. We service it to the same standard as our other GLC Coupe rebuilds.

A 4.0-litre V8 petrol fitted to the GLC63 AMG in the first-generation X253. Known for valve seal and coolant system wear - see the callout above. We replace valve seals, coolant components and timing chain components as standard on every M177 rebuild.
